privacy.protection_preset.description: Balanced is the default. Strict can reduce website compatibility.
privacy.fingerprint.description: Standardizes selected high-entropy APIs without per-call randomization.
privacy.webrtc.description: Allows WebRTC in Direct mode with non-proxied UDP disabled. Turning it off blocks the API; Tor and Onion always block it.
privacy.trackers.description: Blocks compiled tracker and cryptomining host rules without remote checks.
privacy.third_party_cookies.description: Rejects third-party cookie access unless a site rule allows it.
privacy.referrer.description: Sends only the origin on cross-origin requests.
privacy.gpc.description: Sends Sec-GPC: 1 as a privacy preference signal.
privacy.dnt.description: Sends the optional DNT signal; websites may ignore it.
privacy.clear_cookies_exit.description: Removes Normal-profile cookies when Granger Browser closes.
privacy.clear_cache_exit.description: Clears the Normal-profile HTTP cache when Granger Browser closes.
privacy.clear_storage_exit.description: Deletes normal-profile local storage, IndexedDB, service workers and related databases before the next startup.
privacy.tor_isolation.description: Required safety invariant: Tor browsing uses a separate memory-only WebEngine profile.
privacy.clear_tor_disconnect.description: Clears Tor and Onion memory stores when the route is ended.
privacy.block_fallback.description: Required safety invariant: navigation stops while a selected Tor route is unverified.
privacy.disable_webrtc_tor.description: Required safety invariant because Qt WebEngine cannot guarantee WebRTC over SOCKS/Tor.
privacy.onion_isolation.description: Required safety invariant: .onion pages use a separate memory-only identity.
privacy.javascript.description: JavaScript stays enabled by default; high-risk APIs are controlled separately.
privacy.popups.description: Blocks script-created windows unless a site rule allows them.
privacy.prefetch.description: Stops DNS prefetch and speculative resource requests.
privacy.strip_tracking.description: Removes known campaign identifiers from top-level GET navigations.
privacy.strict_warning: Stronger privacy may reduce website compatibility.
privacy.active_profile.description: The selected configuration is applied to existing and new tabs where supported.
privacy.site_rules.description: Origin rules match an exact scheme, host and port. Domain rules match the domain and its subdomains.
privacy.site_permissions.description: Permanent decisions are saved only when you choose an explicit persistent action.
privacy.site_permissions.none: No persistent site permission decisions are saved.
privacy.permission.title: Site permission
privacy.config_import_export.description: Versioned JSON contains privacy settings and site rules, never credentials, cookies, history or executable paths.
privacy.import_bridges_confirm: Import the bridge lines shown in this preview
privacy.config_preview_ready: Configuration validated. Review the preview before applying.
privacy.config_no_preview: No validated configuration is waiting to be applied.
privacy.permission_invalid: The permission origin, category or decision is invalid.
privacy.profile_reset: Privacy profile reset to Balanced defaults.
privacy.profile_invalid: The profile name or preset is invalid.
privacy.session_cleared: Cookies, cache, visited links and session permission decisions were cleared.
privacy.ua_chromium_required: A custom User-Agent must identify Windows Chromium with the bundled Chromium major version so it remains consistent with Client Hints and navigator properties.
privacy.diagnostics.local_only: Tests run locally in the current WebEngine profile. Results are not uploaded to Granger Browser servers.
privacy.forget_site.title: Forget site data
privacy.forget_site.confirm: Remove stored data and saved permissions for %1?
privacy.forget_site.detail: Removes domain cookies, local and session storage, IndexedDB, CacheStorage, service workers, and the exact-origin privacy rule. Qt WebEngine cannot clear HTTP cache for only one site, so shared HTTP cache is left intact.
privacy.forget_site.invalid: Open the site itself before forgetting its origin data.
privacy.forget_site.done: Site cleanup completed. Visible cookies: %1; IndexedDB databases: %2; CacheStorage entries: %3; service workers: %4. Domain cookies were also removed through the WebEngine cookie store.
privacy.forget_site.menu_hint: Use Forget this site from the site-information menu while the site is open so origin storage can be cleared in its own security context.
privacy.tor_session_ended.description: The verified Tor route was lost and its memory-only browser identity was discarded.
privacy.tor_session_ended.detail: The page was not retried over Direct. Reconnect and wait for route verification before loading it again.
